about: The route drawn by hand on Route 1 (light blue line on route_frlg_r1.png), decoded against pokefirered and checked in issue #7. Southbound from Viridian City to Pallet Town, hopping ledges on the west side and keeping out of the grass but for the gap at the bottom. Each waypoint is a leg: its direction and where it ends; 'or' lists the other ends accepted for that waypoint (the leg may run one row over). Places are [map, x, y]. The maps come from a local pokefirered checkout and are not committed.

waypoints.note: through the gap in Viridian's row-30 ledge at x 20..22; Viridian x 22 is Route 1 x 10
the west side, hopping the ledges at rows 5, 10, 15 and 20; no grass
along a row below the row-20 ledge; no grass
hops the row-26 ledge; not the row-31 ledge at x 20, which leads into grass
back west on the sandy path
hops the row-31 ledge; the grass gap at rows 35..39, x 12..13, is the only grass on the line
